darkworldcoder-market-mirror-market-mirr.description: Analyze real ad data, research markets, survey simulated buyers, and test campaigns, pricing, sales pitches, and product journeys through MarketMirror MCP tools or the local CLI.

darkworldcoder-market-mirror-evidence-re.description: Validate actual marketing exports and assess whether simulated predictions beat a simple baseline.

darkworldcoder-market-mirror-planning.description: Build a campaign plan with audiences, positioning, channels, funnel goals, budget assumptions and executable test specs.

darkworldcoder-market-mirror-research.description: Gather cited public buyer feedback and product evidence before marketing decisions.

darkworldcoder-market-mirror-testing.description: Run controlled marketing and sales simulation tests and studies on the same audience with repeatable seeds.
